description: Five-Algorithm Machine Learning Benchmark for Flood Discrimination

hyperparameters.Logistic Regression: StandardScaler(fit on train) + LogisticRegression(C=1.0, random_state=42, max_iter=1000)
hyperparameters.LightGBM: LGBMClassifier(n_estimators=100, max_depth=4, num_leaves=15, min_child_samples=10, lr=0.05, random_state=42)
hyperparameters.XGBoost: XGBClassifier(n_estimators=100, max_depth=4, lr=0.05, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.8, random_state=42, eval_metric='logloss')

target_definition: Reported flood event (1) vs. landscape background (0). NOT verified flood-free negative.
